web.title: Agentic video understanding in Gemini: Developer Guide
web.description:
# Agentic video understanding in Gemini: Developer Guide
## Developer Guide: Using agentic video understanding in the Gemini API
```
import time
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()

# Upload a video
video_file = client.files.upload(file="path/to/lecture.mp4")

while video_file.state.name == "PROCESSING":
    time.sleep(2)
    video_file = client.files.get(name=video_file.name)

# Use agentic video processing
interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-3.8-flash",
    input=[\
        {\
            "type": "video",\
            "uri": video_file.uri,\
            "mime_type": video_file.mime_type,\
            "processing": "agentic"\
        },\
        {"type": "text", "text": "What are the three main arguments presented?"}\
    ]
)

print(interaction.output_text)
print(interaction.usage.total_tokens)
```

## Mixed-mode and multi-video requests
```
interaction = client.interactions.create(
    model="gemini-3.8-flash",
    input=[\
        # 45-minute reference match: process agentically\
        {\
            "type": "video",\
            "uri": full_match_file.uri,\
            "mime_type": "video/mp4",\
            "processing": "agentic",\
        },\
        # 10-second query clip: process statically\
        {\
            "type": "video",\
            "uri": highlight_snippet_file.uri,\
            "mime_type": "video/mp4",\
            "processing": "static",\
        },\
        {\
            "type": "text",\
            "text": "Find the exact timestamp in the full recording where the highlight sequence occurred.",\
        },\
    ],
)

print(interaction.output_text)
```

## Choosing between agentic and static mode
### When to use `processing="static"`
- **Short video clips (< 5 minutes):** Latency-sensitive queries on short clips, such as product GIFs, UI animations, or social clips where frame-level precision across the entire clip is needed.

web.title: Video understanding - generateContent API
web.description:
# Video understanding
## Refer to timestamps in the content
```
const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
  model: "gemini-3.8-flash",
  contents: [\
    myfile,\
    "What are the examples given at 00:05 and 00:10 supposed to show us?",\
  ],
});
console.log(response.text);
```

## Extract detailed insights from video
```
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model="gemini-3.8-flash",
    contents=[\
        myfile,\
        "Describe the key events in this video, providing both audio and visual details. Include timestamps for salient moments.",\
    ],
)
print(response.text)
```

## Customize video processing
### Set clipping intervals
```
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.generate_content(
    model='models/gemini-3.8-flash',
    contents=types.Content(
        parts=[\
            types.Part(\
                file_data=types.FileData(file_uri='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XEzRZ35urlk'),\
                video_metadata=types.VideoMetadata(\
                    start_offset='1250s',\
                    end_offset='1570s'\
                )\
            ),\
            types.Part(text='Please summarize the video in 3 sentences.')\
        ]
    )
)
```

## Technical details about videos
- **Processing modes**: Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash Lite,
and later models support two video processing modes:
  - **Agentic**: The model dynamically navigates the video, loading
transcript and/or frames and/or audio on demand. This uses up to 88%
fewer tokens for long-form content, though navigation may slightly
increase Time to First Token (TTFT) on short clips (<5 minutes) due to
internal reasoning and tool round-trips before generation begins.
Responses include `MEDIA_PROCESSING` tool call and response parts to
preserve reasoning context across turns. Best for long-form videos to
optimize token costs and response quality. Supported on Gemini 3.8 Flash,
3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash Lite. See
[Agentic video understanding](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/video-understanding#agentic-video-understanding) for details.
